assertions.assertion: The claim was denied for CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring).
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The payer states precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The clinical indication documents recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope.
The clinical indication raises concern for intermittent arrhythmia.
The diagnosis code R55 is associated with the syncope/near-syncope.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The diagnosis code Z86.73 is associated with the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances.
The appeal requests reprocessing of the outstanding balance.
The appeal is based on supporting clinical documentation.
